description: GIS datasets for graph-based evacuation modelling of the PGE Narodowy National Stadium in Warsaw is a data set deposited in MOST Wiedzy by its authors Sebastian Bąbiński, Adam Inglot. The dataset contains spatial input data and evacuation simulation outputs developed for GIS-based modelling of pedestrian evacuation from the PGE Narodowy National Stadium in Warsaw, Poland. Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
